hash_6164799c4186d467: NOTICE: Power is being routed from low-priority operations to accommodate increased needs of production facilities until further notice. In case of emergency, energy flow willl default and must be rerouted via manual override as soon as possible.

Please carefully review the attached list of new delivery clearances to reference against shipping manifests. It is crucial that we keep security tight with this increase in activity. Any suspicious vessel or delivery must be detained and reported immediately.
hash_64662c11c54c8241:
After analyzing the collected data on island resources, we will not be increasing the rate of resource collection from the island. Instead, we will be importing more shipments from external sources, so processing will still require additional power. I know there's concern about extra strain on the system, but with careful maintenance, we should be able to keep things running smoothly.

If anyone needs to reference the resource data in the future, the SSD has been moved off-site to Outpost for safe keeping.
hash_64662b11c54c808e: Excellent news from the Weapons Research team! Results indicate that we have finally solved the Nova-7 leakage during the ammunition infusion and expulsion processes. Unlike the previous several prototypes that were exposing our own infantry to the gas, this new model will ensure that only our enemies will be in danger. We look forward to hosting a live demonstration at your earliest convenience.
hash_64662e11c54c85a7:
Following several recent containment incidents, we'd like to remind everyone that developing an unstable chemical carries high risk, which is why we must all follow the H.E.L.P. procedure:

1. Hold your breath
2. Evacuate the area
3. Locate a medical facility
4. Provide data

In the case of accidental exposure, volunteering valuable research data is the best way to improve safety for everyone else in the future.
hash_64662d11c54c83f4:
RE:RE: Shipping Quantities
I know they don't want to push partial-loads, but production is slow and it's dangerous to hold onto this unstable stuff for so long. Yeah, there's extra cost in sending to Europe and other targets many times over, but we're piling up ticking time bombs here! The crew's safety has gotta be worth the investment. Frame it as mitigating risk if it would go over better upstairs, larger shipments mean more to lose in a single accident en-route, etc. Just please take it up the chain, I'm begging you.
hash_64663011c54c890d:
VSS Connection Status

Security protocols and signal encryption are fully implemented. You should be receiving secure surveillance intel directly from the Verdansk Signal Station no later than this afternoon. Do not hesitate to come to me directly with any concerns. We realize this line of communication is an invaluable tool for staying ahead of threats to our Nova-7 development and ensuring uninterrupted connection will be considered a top priority for my team.
hash_64662f11c54c875a:
Greetings Guild Recruit,
And welcome to your new home! This beautiful island is the site of incredible progress, as you have already seen for yourself. We're expecting excellence from everyone selected to be part of this very special opportunity, which is why we've provided you with this top-notch assigned living unit. We hope you enjoyed your tour of the island and are already feeling familiarized with the facilities. Now make sure to get a good night's sleep, since you'll need it for tomorrow when the hard work begins!

Three Blind Mice

hash_4b74d7d760a38d4a: Eliminate the other enemy team or be holding the package when the round is over to win the round.
hash_4b74d8d760a38efd: Downed teammates can be revived one time. First team to hit the round score limit wins!
hash_49fb73b3fda108ac: Edit loadout allows you to configure your own battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Killstreaks, and Field Upgrades.
hash_7d97b6530fa409ca: Create A Class allows you to configure your own battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Munitions, and Roles.

hash_3bb6869e4621245: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your class. Perks give your soldier special abilities on the battlefield, while Munitions and Roles allow you provide support to your team.
hash_49fb75b3fda10c12: You may create and name multiple loadouts for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level up and unlock new functionality. You can set your favorite loadout to see it on the gun bench and in the hands of your Operator in the menus.

bundles from the ^5Store ^7or unlocked via the ^5Battle Pass^7.
hash_53bca62596fd497d: Missions are multi-step challenges that can be completed for XP bonuses and special rewards.
hash_53bca32596fd4464: Missions must be activated in order to complete them. Activate a Mission from the Missions page and track your progress. You will be notified when you complete each step and when you have completed your overall objectives.
hash_53bca42596fd4617: There are several Missions available, with more to be released in each new season. Be sure to check back to the Missions page for new challenges and rewards.
hash_3718193cde06e18: Custom Mods are weapons that you create, customize, and save into your Armory. Mod slots are unlocked by leveling each weapon.
hash_3718493cde07331: Create a Custom Mod in Gunsmith by adding attachments, customizing with camos and charms, and then saving it into one of your Mod Slots. You can personalize its name to make it stand out.
hash_3718393cde0717e: Custom Mods track stats, so your weapon will build a history. As long as your Mod retains the same base weapon and name, you may continue to modify it.
hash_70acb2d5523f8e20: For a limited time, hop into Modern Warfare's multiplayer mode to rank up, level your guns and complete challenges.
hash_70acb5d5523f9339: A wide variety of Maps and Game-modes are live in the Multiplayer Trial playlist.
hash_70acb4d5523f9186: If you upgrade you can choose what you want to play, when you want to play it. hash_4bb31163199be0ed: Munitions can be equipped before going in game by spending points won by playing the game.

hash_4bb30f63199bdd87: Activate munitions using the radial menu. Points will be spent when they are used.

hash_1cd1472a1d8d4245: Increases your Containment Level to start each Deployment with bonuses that give you an extra advantage on the battlefield.
hash_75380e7795a45f9: Level up and customize your Loadout weapons. Use Jailbreak machines in Strongholds to upgrade their rarity and boost damage.

hash_7537ee7795a4293: Select Abilities that align with your Skill Tracks to craft Operator Builds tailored to your combat style.
hash_56cf25622bb23649: Your C-Link C.O.M.B.A.T. OS is fully unlocked, customize your weapons and abilities to prepare for combat. You’ll need every edge to survive what’s ahead.

hash_14c82bfa4b1c2558: Passive bonuses can be mixed and matched to fit your playstyle. Use them to boost your strengths or cover your weaknesses.

hash_11e1567c49d1f97c: Perks have been adjusted to help create more balanced choices. Weak and unpopular perks have been buffed! Read the notes in the perk descriptions to find out more about what has changed for each perk.
hash_11e1597c49d1fe95: ^5Overkill ^7is now a red slot perk and must be picked against some of the strongest perks in the game. Combine it with scavenger to keep yourself fully loaded for any situation.
hash_11e1587c49d1fce2: ^5Kill Chain ^7has been moved to the blue slot. Combine it with Hardline or Pointman for a super charged killstreak loadout.
onboarding/plunder_hint_text_1: Loot, complete Contracts and take cash from rival players.

hash_5b2196c5647c729a:
When a genetic condition threatened to take her out of the fight, Leilani "50/50" Tupuola joined an experimental bionics program and was equipped with cybernetic limbs that gave her enhanced reflexes, precision, and endurance. Convinced she’s living on borrowed time, this fierce fighter makes every second count. 

She brings a vital humanity to Specter One that keeps her teammates sane and grounded. Tough, resourceful, with an armor-plated heart of gold, 50’s the soul of her team.
hash_7d49275b799b4e84:
Capt. Nora Anderson is a decorated Air Force veteran whose exploits are legendary across the special forces community. Her unique skill set combines piloting impossible strike missions with the ability to lead surgical, boots-on-the-ground operations. 

She earned the trust of her teammates and a reputation for being cool under fire through her years of classified combat experience. Her mission-first mindset is a force multiplier in any battlespace.
hash_218b4643621be4e4: Leon Rook was selected for the Guild’s C-Link program for one reason: reliability under extreme conditions. A career mercenary with a history of high-casualty engagements, Rook demonstrated an unusual resistance to stress, fear, and psychological deterrence during candidate testing. The C-link integration amplified those traits, transforming a physically dominant soldier into a mentally optimized weapon. Now deployed under Dorne’s direct supervision, Rook represents the benchmark for what the Guild intends to manufacture – a new generation of unstoppable warfighters.
hash_55cb2d7dd22a3cd2: Danny “Blackjack” Li made his name as a fixer within the 54 Immortals, arranging weapons, contraband, and introductions for high-profile clients. Years of operating across the black market as both broker and supplier have made him difficult to surprise and impossible to intimidate. Discreet, adaptable, and uniquely resourceful, Blackjack’s ability to work in the spaces between criminal syndicates and military contracts have made him a useful asset to the 54I, and an increasingly recognizable name in the global arms trade.
hash_20be70b5a735aed2: Scorn operates as an autonomous frontline enforcer specializing in high-risk, short-window missions. Outfitted with full-body reactive plating and the latest in assault technology, he is custom built for direct engagement. Training in urban suppression and armored breach tactics combined with off-the-charts physical metrics provide innumerable advantages when deployed to CQB environments. No known military record has been linked to Scorn, but rumors tie him to multiple black-budget research programs - the existence of which the CIA vehemently denies.
hash_4a80da242be09428:
A dedicated family man, a comedic legend, and what some might call a "muscle daddy," Terry Crews gears up to replace you so you can stack up wins in Black Ops.

Are his biceps registered weapons? Probably. Do his pecs do all the talking? Definitely.

Whether he's slinging lead or pumping iron, this Replacer is ready for duty.
hash_591fee13700f3108:
Major Mackenzie Carver comes from a family line of military excellence and distinguished himself with exceptional skill and commitment to his country and brothers-in-arms. Despite being stripped of his rank, he maintained his mental and physical discipline throughout his incarceration, determined to restore his reputation.

Carver leaves Janus Towers with his fury at the Dark Aether sharpened, reforged into a burning clarity of purpose. No longer content to follow orders, he embraces the role of protector, seeking to carve out a future where humanity can stand on its own, free of masters mortal or cosmic.
hash_7269ccbb959bce51:
Cipher is the renegade hybrid product of a black budget project that fused condemned inmates with advanced combat sub-systems. Augmented reflexes, enhanced physiology, and an electrically stimulated bloodlust ensure high lethality in any environment.

Escaping during a bloody uprising, Cipher's team now operate as mercenaries, harboring a burning vendetta against those that created them.
hash_697a561db435b89f:
Tank Dempsey is a battle-hardened Marine who most recently fought through the jungles of 1968 Vietnam with grit, sarcasm, and a relentless will to survive. 

In this fractured reality, his distrust of his new companions and the unfamiliar surroundings have turned this otherwise dependable soldier into an unpredictable wild card.
hash_3785f1612f6b8652: Propelled by academic brilliance and sheer ambition, Victoria Atwood ascended from modest origins to the pinnacle of her field. A pioneer in medical prosthetics and robotics, her research became known for pushing beyond accepted limits, earning her a reputation for getting results, and generating controversy - and eventually, a position at the head of the Guild’s technology branch. Now leading the corporation’s most sensitive research programs, she seeks to revolutionize the way soldiers fight, giving the Guild a new edge in the race to control the battlefield.
hash_6279b45906e429b7:
A technological visionary, Gideon Falkner was handpicked by Emma Kagan to head the Guild’s bio-engineering team – a role that exposed him to the shadowy world of the corporation’s clandestine operations. 

Though publicly known as a scientific savant, Falkner has also proven a gifted field agent, though his prolonged exposure to a wide array of neurotoxins in his lab work have left him paranoid and erratic. Regardless, he remains one of Kagan’s favored tools within the Guild.
hash_1c154ff8b112e4d7:
Very little is known about The Replacer and that’s just how he likes it. Birthdate, dietary restrictions, favorite subspecies of spoon-billed sandpiper? You don’t need to know. None of it matters. 

What does? 

Everything he knows about you. He will replace you in your life, so you can get all the Black Ops time your sick little heart desires. He doesn’t provide a service - he gets results. 

You can rest assured when he clocks in, someone’s clocking out. Permanently.
hash_6ab57d3565687d54:
A highly educated and brilliant scientist, Dr. Elizabeth Grey is renowned for her groundbreaking discoveries in the study of Aetherium. However, turbulent events and sinister uses of her discoveries led her down a dark path. Transformed by years of imprisonment at the hand of the former Director of Requiem, she uses her genius and scientific mind to ensure her team maintains every tactical advantage. 

Grey walks away from Janus Towers with her victories tempered by a growing unease; the gnawing doubt that science may not be able to truly mend the damage it has wrought. Once a steadfast believer in reason, she now is starting to suspect that survival may demand something beyond the equations and experiments that once brought her comfort.
hash_53220d35a0b12438:
A tech genius born into the era of AI, Anika Grimm took to building and piloting autonomous drones as naturally as breathing. Now employed by the Guild to oversee production and deployment of their vast drone fleets, she is one of Emma Kagan’s most trusted hands, and has also earned recognition as a highly capable field agent specializing in battlefield reconnaissance and assessment. 

Though she isn’t one to make friends, Grimm’s coworkers value her for her cunning mind, perceptive eye, and ruthless commitment to getting the job done.
hash_37d3d62effd12f6c:
Harper’s approach hasn’t changed much over the course of his career: get in clean, keep the team tight, finish what you start. His combat record proves the effectiveness of this approach, with more operational hours clocked and more successful missions than anyone in his unit. 

Blunt, direct, and fiercely loyal, he is respected across JSOC for his consistency and tactical awareness. When chaos hits, he’s the kind of soldier you want on your side of the firing line.
hash_296fd9953892cf7f: Highly trained and specializing in unconventional warfare, the Hunter Killer Unit are some of South Korea’s most precise, most devastating soldiers. Thanks to their resilience, discipline, unmatched skill, and countless successful missions, they are a favorite ally of the US military. Whether they’re in the air, water or on the ground, the arrival of the HKU ensures victory.
hash_131d0a82f0431869: Lucy is a resident of Vault 33 devoted to her community. She’s active in the Young Pipefitter’s Association, gymnastics, fencing, and riflery, and loves teaching American history with a focus on ethics. Most of her free time is spent with her father, Hank, gardening, watching movies, and joining their book club. When Hank is captured by Lee Moldaver, Lucy leaves the Vault to rescue him and soon discovers how harsh the Wasteland is. Facing violence, betrayal, and the truth about her father’s past, she stays upbeat and quick-thinking. Her optimism hardens into resolve as she sets out to bring him to justice.
hash_26ccab67c5d8745f:
Ciro Jurado operates with a swagger that demands attention. While others may brand him a bellicose loose-cannon, below the surface he’s a cunning tactician with an elite skillset honed by relentless training. When he goes loud, he delivers brutal, almost feral violence capable of shattering enemy morale and turning the momentum. 

While his methods don’t make him many friends, his unquestionable efficacy on the battlefield makes him invaluable to his employer.
hash_1060008c2e13e170:
CEO of transnational private security corporation The Guild, Emma Kagan is relentless in her pursuit of global market dominance. Though she started as a humble analyst, Kagan’s business acumen and talent for manipulating office politics aided her rapid rise to the highest echelons of the company. 

She developed a reputation as a formidable ally, but was quick to drop those that held her back. The old guard executives fueled Kagan’s rise to power, only to be ousted by the very ambition they had come to admire.
hash_3355128c89eac32e:
Chloe “Karma” Lynch’s transition from code-breaker to mission command came shortly after the 2025 Menendez attacks, where her technical skillset and cool head under pressure proved invaluable to recovery efforts. Her innate tactical instincts are matched by a deep understanding of the modern connected battlefield, and her ability to cut through the noise keeps her teams alive and on mission. 

With her broad experience, Karma knows when to lead, when to delegate, and when to get her hands back on the terminal, making her the ideal choice to oversee JSOC’s field operations.
hash_35be9e98c7c7afe5:
Following in the footsteps of her brother, Wei Lin graduated medical school and joined the army, where she distinguished herself during dangerous peacekeeping and disaster relief operations, saving countless lives under fire and forging a reputation for herself that would eventually lead to a collaboration with JSOC. 

Known for her personal resilience, dedication to rigorous study, and higher sense of duty, Lin is a battlefield enigma – an experienced soldier who can save a life as easily as she can take one.
hash_2d683b607771b5c0:
Determined to serve like his father before him, David "Section" Mason rose through the military ranks and now leads Specter One: an elite counterterrorism unit defending the world from high-risk threats.  His bold tactics and battlefield instincts are tempered by a deep responsibility for the lives of his teammates. 

Guarded, precise, and operating with complete control, David is as comfortable running point for the JSOC team as he is back home at his dad’s cabin in Alaska.
hash_62ff7860964180d9:
Trained in the family business of smuggling since she was a child, Maya Aguinaldo brings stealth, covert tactics, and a sharp mind to every engagement.

Her pursuit of the Syndicate that abducted her brother threw her into Requiem’s path when she helped free their leaders on Terminus Island. Though out of her depth in the science and machinations of the Dark Aether, her grit, grief, and hard-earned street instincts made her an essential ally in a fight far larger than her own.

Uncertain of her role within her newfound ‘family’, the events of Janus Towers removed her luxury of choice, as once again she has to throw in with allies old and new if she is to have any chance of survival.
hash_7ee23b9ac39488b7: He’s a Master of the Custodial Arts, but don’t call him a “janitor” — he’s the buddy that brings the buds. This Mr. Nice Guy will have your back — though don’t expect him to buy you lunch. And while he’s all about Mary Jane, he can still bring the fight with his crew and a piranha.
hash_255d47969b469661:
Soviet tank commander Nikolai Belinski arrives in the Dark Aether from the brutal, mountainous landscape of 1984 Afghanistan, where duty, disillusionment, and misfortune collided.

Scarred by war and haunted both by betrayal and his own decisions, he masks his bitterness with dark humor, yet remains a steadfast warrior when the shells begin to fall.
hash_98d2cf5591f8087: An elite specialist engineered for total battlefield fluidity, Phantom moves unseen through contested environments using electromagnetic adaptive armor. Equal parts infiltrator and tactician, his training spans close-quarters combat, long-range operations, and sensor-denied warfare, making him an invaluable weapon in the Guild’s black budget arsenal.
hash_1b9d2c820b1ded43: In the first age, in the first battle, when the shadows first lengthened, one stood. Burned by the embers of Armageddon, his soul blistered by the fires of Hell and tainted beyond ascension, he chose the path of perpetual torment. In his ravenous hatred he found no peace; and with boiling blood he scoured the Umbral Plains seeking vengeance against the dark lords who had wronged him. He wore the crown of the Night Sentinels, and those that tasted the bite of his sword named him... the Doom Slayer.
hash_688b7eab83758687: After losing his family as a child, Maximus was raised by the Brotherhood of Steel, who became his only home. Haunted by fear of weakness, he seeks power to protect himself from the dangers of the Wasteland. While on a Brotherhood mission, he serves under Knight Titus until a Yao Guai attack leaves Titus wounded. Faced with a choice between saving him or taking his armor, Max steals the armor and his identity, setting off on a dangerous path of survival and self-discovery. Saved later by Lucy, he begins to question the Brotherhood’s strict code and his own ambitions. By the end, Max earns the rank of Knight he long desired, but doubts what it truly means.
hash_f19dd3a62b59ffb: Revenant is a specialist in digital intrusion and clandestine field work. His equipment pairs experimental systems with reactive resin masking and chroma-shifting armor, allowing him to hunt from the shadows while his targets are unaware. This technology - unreliable in untrained hands - is maintained personally by Prism between deployments. Methodical under pressure, Revenant is uniquely adapted for assessing hostile networks and identifying weaknesses and infiltration routes. No physical facility or digital fortress is safe when he lays his sights on it.
hash_1a817c5fa8aa12c0: Donovan is a veteran HALO diver specializing in high-risk solo insertions into heavily contested territory. Trained in infiltration, reconnaissance, and close-quarters combat, he executes missions with minimal support and no margin for error. Long deployments in black operations have left him blunt, self-reliant, and willing to bend the rules if the objective demands it. Despite that reputation, Donovan never hesitates to take the jump when others won’t, making him one of JSOC’s most valued operators.
hash_3dfa3c5fbcfd47ba:
Slade “Razor” Barrick is an American-trained former private security contractor turned JSOC operative. A highly capable soldier with a large ego and a flair for bravado, he leads the special ops squad Specter Two. Though often assigned jobs in support of David Mason’s Specter One team, Razor insists his squad is every bit as capable of leading operations to success. 

Tough and resourceful, Razor is a menace on the battlefield, and while some among JSOC leadership worry about his loose leadership style, no one can question his results.
hash_79802ecf47fbdd89:
Experimental War Robot 3 - nicknamed “Reaper” in homage to the callsign of the program’s human operator - represents a breakthrough in human-robot engineering. An advanced combat platform operated remotely by a highly decorated veteran, the Reaper EWR-3 system combines state-of-the-art engineering and robotic precision with real-time human decision making to provide an elite tactical advantage in hostile environments. 

Unlike similar systems, the operator maintains a full battlefield presence through the integrated cranial connection, providing a unique opportunity for the retired combatant to return to action.
hash_53c87722046690c2:
Dr. Edward Richtofen, a brilliant but unhinged scientist and hero of the Reich, finds himself torn from 1945 in a world where the Axis Powers triumphed over the Allied Nations.

Shaped by ambition and tainted by corruption, he masks his innate sadism and considerable ego behind quick wit and a charming smile. He vows that reality itself will ultimately bow to his designs.
hash_64bc748b13a2f552:
Eric Samuels was part of President Bosworth’s Secret Service detail responsible for safely transporting her through Los Angeles during Menendez's drone attacks in 2025 - a battle in which Samuels fought alongside experienced NAVY SEAL and JSOC operatives David Mason and Mike Harper. Old school and tough as nails, Samuels' peers look to him for leadership and strength in times of crisis. 

His ability to spot threats well before they materialize, coupled with his cool head in a firefight, make him an exceptional protector -  qualities that enabled his transition to a Delta Force operative and eventual recruitment into Specter One.
hash_7f65a30ae6c675e: A Confederate soldier corrupted by the Dark Aether as much as his own ideologies. Across centuries in the strange un-time of the Dark Aether, the Warden grew steadily in power and understanding, eventually subjugating the dimension's most powerful denizens, the beings known as Shadowsmiths. After enslaving the mysterious Entity, the Warden turned his sights on the realms beyond the Dark Aether, believing it his destiny to bend all reality to his will.
hash_25e082261823ce4e: Nicolas Cage doesn't do half-measures; when he’s in, he’s all the way in. Every role, every mission, he brings a razor-sharp edge and an intensity you simply can't look away from. Whether wiping a squad or stealing the show, he delivers a full-throttle performance every. damn. time.
hash_1c31a7f78d39d8a2:
Next to nothing is known about the presumed wet-works specialist Spectre. The designation itself is a codename agreed on by the various agencies that have pooled their intelligence on unsolved assassinations, inferring his or her existence based on either evidence found at the scene, or from fragmentary reports given by shaken bystanders.

Despite heavy redaction, all accounts suggest an individual capable of extraordinary stealth; able to evade or neutralize the most sophisticated of manned or automated security set ups.

In every case, Spectre’s victims have been slain with surgically precise mid-line stab wounds with rarely any signs of struggle.
hash_183be4ff65e2111b:
She’s The Replacer. You might not recognize her, but she recognizes you. She knows everything about you: your address, your favorite color, that thing you looked up at 2 a.m. last night. She even knows your joystick preferences. Inverted? You’re kinda freaky like that. 

It’s not important.
What’s important is her particular set of skills. She’ll replace you in your life, so you can focus on getting win after win in Black Ops. It’s not a job; it’s her calling.
She clocks in so you can lock in. You know what to do. Bring the pain.
hash_3bbe06f1cccf3c55: RoboCop was a dutiful Detroit Police Officer who was shot and killed in the line of duty. Through the use of OCP technology, the fallen officer was resurrected as the part man, part machine, all cop hero known as RoboCop! Following his prime directives to serve the public trust, Protect the innocent, and Uphold the law, RoboCop is ready to clean up the streets.
hash_7b09414ba2e5b9c2:
Takeo Masaki is a disgraced ronin who wandered 1591 Feudal Japan without master or honor, carrying the weight of his exile as a yoke he cannot cast off. 

Bound by a code he only still barely believes in, he seeks redemption in the chaos of battle – his blade both a burden he must bear, and a judgment on his enemies.
hash_2e445dd12a206c65:
Originally assigned as a civilian bus driver, T.E.D.D. has spent an unknown amount of time stranded in a hostile, alien dimension - the Dark Aether. This experience has significantly impacted his mental state. 

Known for erratic outbursts and fits of unpredictable violence, his psychological instability, while concerning, has made him an effective combatant. The robotic bus driver is best approached with caution – and a valid ticket.
hash_301ea8e6944863a2: Once known as Cooper Howard, The Ghoul has survived the Wasteland longer than most, working as a ruthless but skilled bounty hunter. Beneath his irradiated exterior lies the memory of a former Marine and Hollywood actor famous for Westerns. Before the war, his wife Barb, an executive at Vault-Tec, urged him to promote their “apocalypse-proof” products, but growing doubts about the company and his wife began to take root. When the bombs fell on Los Angeles, Cooper endured the blast, mutating into a ghoul and spending centuries haunted by the hope that his family survived. Years later, he crosses paths with an idealistic vault dweller whose arrival reignites his search for what he lost long ago.
hash_34398ec050d042c3: Outfitted with a next-generation mobility rig and neural-linked targeting suite, Valkyrie was designed for warfare in dense battlespaces. Her gear is optimized for rapid insertion, flanking maneuvers, and high-angle engagement. Enhanced reaction speed and combat training make her unequivocally dangerous in close quarters. Developed through the CIA’s experimental augmentation programs, she represents a new class of battlefield asset—part soldier, part weapons platform.
hash_3ca7fedfd2038e59: Catalyst is part of an elite mercenary squad specializing in operations within biologically hazardous environments. Deployed where conventional forces simply cannot go, Catalyst executes missions involving industrial toxins, weaponized pathogens, and containment zone breaches with consistent success. His resilience is the result of an experimental nano-virus integrated directly into his bloodstream. This bio-system actively responds to environmental threats, allowing Catalyst to maintain operational capacity even under extreme conditions. The result is a self-sustaining asset capable of entering and enduring the most hostile battlefield scenarios imaginable.
hash_40062275327ba679:
A hardened South African recon specialist, Axel Vermaak’s years of dangerous scout work make him an ideal addition to the JSOC squad. Composed and devastatingly efficient, he is as proficient in a firefight as he is at gathering intel. 

Originally recruited for his ability to track terrorist threats in the field, his tactical instincts and poise under pressure have made him an invaluable asset in the fight against the Guild.
hash_4d1354bf011119b7: Intelligent yet ruthless, Dorne rose through the ranks of the Guild in Emma Kagan’s shadow, acting as her right-hand man and all-purpose fixer. His cunning mind is offset by a streak of uncontrollable rage, but his willingness to do the unthinkable makes him dangerous in a way Kagan never was. Now, with her removed and the Guild under his control, Dorne has set his long dormant plans in motion.
hash_60cb9439dfd1eb21:
A Ranger-trained CIA operative, Grigori Weaver’s combat acumen and espionage know-how have carried him through countless engagements. After his mother defected from the former Soviet Union, Weaver dedicated his life to exceptional military service in clandestine operations. Haunted by tactical errors and driven by a desire to fight for something he believes in, Weaver stands strong with those who fight beside him.

Weaver has been transformed by the fall of Janus Towers – no longer a shadowy spy master, he has become a hardened leader forged by sacrifice. With Requiem shattered, he gathers the broken pieces in the fight against the Dark Aether, determined to ensure his friends survive.
hash_3ec03d4f5bec9ddf:
Deadly precision, unbreakable composure, and a steady hand define Priya Zaveri. At home with a rifle to her shoulder, she is the Guild’s highest-rated marksman – and their highest paid. In the field, she’s often found at elevation, picking off targets with brutally accurate kill shots, though she’s equally at home with CQB and heavy weaponry. 

A top-rated performer all her life, she’s hard to impress and isn’t afraid to make her disdain known through a caustic retort or a high-velocity round – depending on the situation.

zm_sat_augment/desc_aethershroud_afterim: Distract Normal and Special Enemies with a Dark Aether clone of yourself.
zm_sat_augment/desc_aethershroud_burstda: Warp forward a short distance, killing all Normal Enemies in your path.
zm_sat_augment/desc_aethershroud_extensi: Aether Shroud duration is significantly increased.
zm_sat_augment/desc_aethershroud_impulse: Deal Shadow damage to nearby enemies on activation and gain increased movement speed while active.
zm_sat_augment/desc_aethershroud_instant: Activation gives your currently held weapon ammo and instantly reloads it.
zm_sat_augment/desc_aethershroud_voidshe: Swap to your Dedicated Melee Weapon as it's imbued with Dark Aether energy. Kills extend the Aether Shroud duration.
zm_sat_augment/desc_brainrot_biggame: Brain Rot can charm Elite Enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_brainrot_causticfume: Charmed enemies deal Toxic damage to nearby enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_brainrot_explosive: Charmed enemies explode at the end of Brain Rot's duration, dealing Toxic damage.
zm_sat_augment/desc_brainrot_extension: Brain Rot's charm duration is increased.
zm_sat_augment/desc_brainrot_pheromone: The charmed enemy distracts nearby Normal and Special Enemies for a short time.
zm_sat_augment/desc_brainrot_plague: Charmed enemies have a chance to turn other enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_brainrot_superserum: Increase the damage dealt by charmed enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_cryofreeze_biggame: Cryo Freeze can slow Elite enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_cryofreeze_coldcompa: Cryo Freeze will occasionally affect enemies in a small radius.
zm_sat_augment/desc_cryofreeze_icecloud: Enemies that are killed while frozen may leave a cloud that slows enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_cryofreeze_thermalsh: Enemies are damaged once they're unfrozen.
zm_sat_augment/desc_darkflare_broadbeam: Significantly increase the size of the beam.
zm_sat_augment/desc_darkflare_darkpact: The beam heals and revives other players on contact.
zm_sat_augment/desc_darkflare_duskflame: Special and Elite Enemies that are hit by the beam are dealt additional Shadow damage over time.
zm_sat_augment/desc_darkflare_heavygloom: The beam slows enemies on contact.
zm_sat_augment/desc_darkflare_muzzleblas: The beam now deals additional damage in a cone in front of you.
zm_sat_augment/desc_darkflare_supernova: The beam is replaced with a sphere that damages nearby enemies as it travels and detonates at the end of its duration.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deadshotdaiquiri_dea: Critical hits have a chance of returning a bullet to your magazine.
Increase bullet damage to armor pieces.
Bullets deal double Critical Damage if an enemy is at full health.
Further increase Deadshot Daiquiri's Critical Damage Bonus for guns.
Temporarily increase your movement speed after getting a Point Blank Kill with a gun.
Reduce weapon movement during advanced movement.
Bullets deal bonus damage to enemies within Point Blank range.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deadwire_aftershock: Enemies that are stunned by Dead Wire have a chance to spread the stun to nearby enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deadwire_balllightni: Dead Wire launches an orb that deals Electric damage to nearby enemies as it moves.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deadwire_biggame: Dead Wire can stun Elite Enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deadwire_chainlightn: The stunned enemy can spread the stun to others.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deadwire_extension: The stun and electric field last longer.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deadwire_lightningst: A bolt of lightning strikes from above, stunning all Normal and Special Enemies in the area.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_bird: The minimap scan rate is increased.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_crit: Body shots with normal bullet weapons have a chance to deal Critical Damage.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_deat: Your Elemental Weakness damage has a chance to kill an enemy that is low on health.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_extr: Find extra Essence under more locations.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_furt: See enemies through walls from farther away.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_hidd: Death Perception can now see loot.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_sixt: Sense enemies close behind you and take less damage from behind.
zm_sat_augment/desc_deathperception_trea: Spot items others can miss from loot containers as well as Special and Elite Kills.
zm_sat_augment/desc_doubletap_doublecali: Bullet weapons have increased penetration damage through enemies.
zm_sat_augment/desc_doubletap_doubledeal: Every 4th bullet in your weapon magazine deals double damage.
zm_sat_augment/desc_doubletap_doubleimpa: For normal bullet weapons, every other successive hit on the same target deals bonus damage.
zm_sat_augment/desc_doubletap_doublejeop: Normal Zombies at low health have a chance to die immediately when shot by normal bullet weapons.
zm_sat_augment/desc_doubletap_doubleorno: Normal bullet weapons have a chance to do double damage, but also have a small chance to do no damage.

ztron_gobble_gum/tactical_diffiusion_des: [Lasts 90 Seconds or 3 uses] Each nuke you use also grants $2000 to use in the SlayerMart.
ztron_gobble_gum/temporal_gift_desc: [Activates on Next Time-Based Power-Up] Activated Power-Up lasts 2x longer. Stacks with Fate of Fortune.
ztron_gobble_gum/time_out_desc: [Lasts 30 Minutes] Within 30 seconds of the start of each new round, a Nuke will activate free of charge.
ztron_gobble_gum/turn_coat_desc: Nearby zombies are temporarily turned to do your bidding.
ztron_gobble_gum/wall_power_desc: [Lasts 1 Round] Electric poles do not damage you.
ztron_gobble_gum/wall_to_wall_clearance_: [Lasts 2 Minutes] A Nuke will activate free of charge on your position every 10 Seconds. Global cooldown of 15 minutes.
ztron_gobble_gum/whos_keeping_score_desc: [Lasts 5 Minutes] Treasure spawn rates are significantly increased.
ztron_gobble_gum/wonderbar_desc: [Lasts 30 Minutes] At the start of each round, either become a Mutant or receive a chicken.
hash_967b0a63230a3cd: Your adventure starts back on the Island. Always the Island
hash_967ada632309eb4: The larger the gem, the bigger the boost to your score multiplier
hash_967aea63230a067: You can press [{+weapnext}] to toggle the camera modes
